crossRefs.note: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t…
See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see…
When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw…
Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy…
He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach…
It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is Yahweh! We…
They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

parallels.note: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

translations.web: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
translations.bsb: After He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side. The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.
translations.kjv: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
translations.asv: And when he had said this, he showed unto them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad, when they saw the Lord.
